name: Patient health-record breach
description: Records exfiltrated by attacker, lost device, mis-sent letter or insider snooping. Special-category data fine band + ICO investigation.

name: Serious clinical incident
description: Mis-diagnosis, prescribing error, procedural complication causes serious harm. GMC/GDC referral, negligence claim, regulator notification.

name: Loss / theft of controlled drugs
description: Controlled drug missing from CD cupboard or register. Home Office investigation; possible licence loss.

name: Failed regulator inspection
description: CQC / equivalent finds breach of fundamental standards. Conditions, warning notice, or suspension.

name: Failure of informed consent
description: Procedure performed without documented informed consent in line with Montgomery / national rules. Negligence claim and regulator referral.
